component.name: ePass2003 (Feitian)
component.summary: Driver for the ePass2003 formatted by Feitian's Windows software, for Tessera
Driver do ePass2003 formatado pelo programa da Feitian para Windows, para o Tessera

description.p: Experimental. The ePass2003 that certificate authorities deliver is formatted by Feitian's Windows software, in a layout OpenSC does not read. This extension adds Feitian's own PKCS#11 library for it, so browsers, PDF readers and document signers that use Tessera's tokens can sign with it. An ePass2003 formatted by OpenSC does not need it: Tessera's built-in OpenSC driver serves it.

Feitian's library talks to the token over USB itself, not through the system's card service (pcscd). It needs two one-time steps, which Tessera's Drivers page shows with the commands to copy: letting Tessera reach the USB devices, and making pcscd leave the ePass2003 to the driver. Until both are done Tessera does not load it, since pcscd and the library talking to the token at once make it stop answering.

This extension installs the 64-bit library of Feitian's EnterSafe Castle SDK for Linux (2014), as Soluti distributes it, downloaded at install time and checked against a pinned checksum. Only the library is taken: no install script runs. It is closed source and not made or endorsed by Tessera's author.
The driver runs inside Tessera's sandbox with Tessera's permissions and has none of its own. After installing it, use Restart Tessera in Tessera's menu.
